title: 第5章 灵球炸弹芳香四溢第6章 狼狈回宗重整旗鼓
content_zh:
一幅奇怪的画面出现在爷孙二人面前。
四只异常强壮的狗整齐的排成一列，为首那只黑狗嘴中叼着一只浑身碧绿的屎壳郎。
茅不易震动双翼，发出嗡嗡的声音。
“人类，离开我的领地！”
陈欣欣见到他们不光没有害怕，反而一脸开心的快步走到他们面前。
她摸了摸黑狗的狗头，随后将茅不易从狗嘴中接过。
陈欣欣双手将他举向空中，阳光洒在茅不易碧绿的身体之上，将其映的如绿宝石一般。
一双琥珀色的美眸不断的打量着他。
“好漂亮的虫虫！”
茅不易并未伤害眼前的少女，四肢无力的在空中摇晃，发出嗡嗡的声音，表示抗议！
“哎，哎！姑娘，咱俩认识吗，你怎么上来就动手动脚的！”
“汪！汪！”
黑狗凑了过来，不断的在其身边转圈，陈欣欣亲昵的摸了摸他的狗头。
“你也很可爱，小狗狗！”
茅不易一脸嫌弃的看向小黑，传音道：
“小黑你跟这姑娘熟吗！你怎么能乱让陌生人摸呢！”
“汪！汪！”
陈欣欣穿着一身洗得发白的粗布衣裙，却难掩其灵秀之气。
其无意间散发的纯净气息，令得身边的生灵不由自主地对其产生好感。
爷爷快步走上前来，浑浊的老眼闪着精光，干枯如柴的手颤抖的伸向摸小黑。

“这……这是一只有了灵智的灵兽！”
陈欣欣一只手环在小黑的脖子上，再度揉了揉她的狗头
“哇，小狗狗你这么厉害啊！”
爷爷又看向欣欣手中的茅不易，双眼之中精光更甚。
“这……这居然是只灵虫！
“发财了，将他们卖掉，就算背井离乡也有足够的钱财过上好日子了！”
听到这老头如此不懂礼数，上来就要将他们卖掉，茅不易振动着翅膀发出警告。
“在我的地盘上把我们卖掉！活腻歪了吧你！”
可惜他现在不能人言，只有嗡嗡的声音传来。
但陈欣欣却能感受到茅不易的愤怒。
她玉指轻轻拂过茅不易的甲壳，抚平了茅不易的情绪。
茅不易心中疑惑道：
“为何待在这女孩身边，心中有种莫名的安定感？”
陈欣欣扭头看向爷爷，双眼之中满是央求。
“爷爷，不要卖他们好不好，我要养着他们。”
爷爷剧烈的咳嗽几声，语重心长的说道：
content_en:
A strange picture appeared in front of the grandfather and grandson.
Four extremely strong dogs lined up neatly. The black dog at the head held a green dung beetle in its mouth.
Mao Buyi vibrated his wings and made a buzzing sound.
"Humans, leave my territory!"
Not only was Chen Xinxin not afraid when she saw them, but she quickly walked up to them with a happy face.
She touched the black dog's head, and then took Mao Buyi from the dog's mouth.
Chen Xinxin lifted him into the air with both hands, and the sun shone on Mao Buyi's green body, reflecting it like an emerald.
A pair of beautiful amber eyes kept looking at him.
"What a beautiful insect!"
Mao Buyi did not harm the girl in front of him. His limbs swayed weakly in the air and made a buzzing sound in protest!
"Hey, hey! Girl, do we know each other? Why did you do something when you came up here!"
"Woof! Woof!"
The black dog came over and kept circling around him. Chen Xinxin touched his head affectionately.
"You're cute too, little pup!"
Mao Buyi looked at Xiao Hei with a look of disgust and said via voice:
"Xiao Hei, are you familiar with this girl? How can you let strangers touch you!"
"Woof! Woof!"
Chen Xinxin was wearing a coarse cloth dress that had been washed white, but she could not conceal her aura of elegance.
The pure aura it exudes unintentionally makes the creatures around it involuntarily have a favorable impression of it.
Grandpa walked forward quickly, his cloudy old eyes shining brightly, and his withered hands tremblingly reached out to touch Xiaohei.
"This... this is a spiritual beast with intelligence!"
Chen Xinxin put one hand around Xiao Hei's neck and rubbed her dog's head again
"Wow, little dog, you are so awesome!"
Grandpa looked at Mao Buyi in Xinxin's hand again, his eyes even brighter.
"This...this is actually a spiritual insect!
“When you get rich, sell them and you will have enough money to live a good life even if you leave your hometown! "
When he heard that the old man was so ignorant of etiquette and wanted to sell them, Mao Buyi flapped his wings and gave a warning.
“Sell us on my land! Are you tired of living? "
It's a pity that he can't speak now, only a humming sound can be heard.
But Chen Xinxin could feel Mao Buyi's anger.
Her jade fingers gently brushed Mao Buyi's carapace, soothing Mao Buyi's emotions.
Mao Buyi was confused and said:
"Why do I feel an inexplicable sense of stability when I stay next to this girl? "
Chen Xinxin turned to look at her grandfather, her eyes full of pleading.
"Grandpa, please don't sell them, I want to keep them. "
Grandpa coughed violently and said seriously:
